item.text: The helper currently decides expiry from the upcoming subscription and returns its date when renewal is disabled. I’ll make cancellation context explicit, and use the active term whenever cancellation is in progress or renewal is disabled; normal enabled-renewal behavior and free-plan handling stay as they are.
